caption: The drawing depicts a stone cross with a roughly textured, light gray surface. At the intersection of the vertical and horizontal arms is a small metal fixture surrounded by a cluster of blue flowers and green leaves, with two blue birds facing each other on either side of the central section. Above the birds, the top arm of the cross is decorated with large orange-red flowers with green stems and leaves. The lower vertical arm contains a recessed niche holding a small white or light gray statue of a woman holding a child, placed on a dark circular base. The inside of the niche is shaded, and the area below it on the cross is painted green with red oval spots and a green line extending downward, representing grass and small flowers. Additional orange-red flowers with green leaves are painted on either side of the statue within the niche. The background is off-white with minimal markings. The signature "MAZEL G. CHAPLIN—TAOS, N. M." appears in the lower right corner.
title: Cement Head Stone
